jei.config.client.appearance.toastReflow: Reserves space for toast notifications so they do not overlap the JEI interface.
jei.message.server.recipe.sync.error: This server sent recipes to JEI, but none were usable. JEI cannot show this server's recipes. Check the server's JEI setup, datapacks, and recipe mods.
jei.message.server.recipe.sync.jei.missi: This %s server does not have JEI installed. JEI is showing default recipes from your client, which may be different on the server. Install JEI on the server to show the server's recipes correctly.
jei.message.server.recipe.sync.unavailab: This %s server does not provide recipes to JEI. JEI is showing default recipes from your client, which may be different on the server.
jei.message.server.recipe.sync.vanilla: This is a vanilla server. JEI is showing default recipes from your client, which may be different if the server uses datapacks. Install Forge, NeoForge, or Fabric on the server, along with JEI, to show the server's recipes correctly.
